# TestScript for 19-shell-completion
# Asserts completion in both wiring styles — self-completing domain types on
# deploy, the predictor registry on exec/logs — plus the full predict SDK
# playground on the logs subcommand

symlink hook.conf -> presets.conf

# 1. Normal command execution (domain-type deploy, registry exec)
exec cloudctl deploy --env staging --cluster staging-cluster-alpha auth
stdout '⚙  cloudctl deploy'
stdout 'deploy \(d\)\s+command\s+—\s+▸ selected'
stdout '-e, --env\s+string\s+staging\s+● cli --env'
stdout '-c, --cluster\s+main\.Cluster\s+staging-cluster-alpha\s+● cli --cluster'
stdout '<service>\s+string\s+auth\s+● cli'

exec cloudctl exec --profile production --namespace frontend web-prod-1 uptime
stdout '⚙  cloudctl exec'
stdout '-n, --namespace\s+string\s+frontend\s+● cli --namespace'
stdout '<target>\s+string\s+web-prod-1\s+● cli'
stdout '<command>\s+string\s+uptime\s+● cli'

# 2. Generate shell completion scripts for all supported shells
exec cloudctl completion bash
stdout '_cloudctl_completion'
stdout 'complete -o noquote -F _cloudctl_completion cloudctl'

exec cloudctl completion zsh
stdout '#compdef cloudctl'
stdout '_cloudctl_completion'

exec cloudctl completion fish
stdout 'function _cloudctl_completion'
stdout 'complete -c .cloudctl.'

exec cloudctl completion powershell
stdout 'Register-ArgumentCompleter'
stdout 'cloudctl'

# Aliases are not accepted; only canonical shell names are valid.
exit-status 2 cloudctl completion pwsh
stderr 'unknown shell "pwsh"'

exit-status 2 cloudctl completion nu
stderr 'unknown shell "nu"'

# elvish and nushell are canonical names with native drivers.
exec cloudctl completion elvish
stdout 'set-env CONGA_SHELL elvish'
stdout '__complete elvish'

exec cloudctl __complete elvish ''
stdout '"value":'

exec cloudctl completion nushell
stdout 'let cloudctl_completer'
stdout '__complete nushell'

exec cloudctl __complete nushell ''
stdout '"value":'

# 3. Usage error on invalid shell name (exit code 2)
exit-status 2 cloudctl completion invalidshell
stderr 'unknown shell "invalidshell"'

# 4. Dynamic completion (JSON export) - Subcommands
exec cloudctl __complete export ''
stdout '"value":"deploy"'
stdout '"value":"d"'
stdout '"value":"logs"'
stdout '"value":"exec"'
stdout '"value":"completion"'

exec cloudctl __complete export dep
stdout '"value":"deploy"'

# 5. Dynamic completion (JSON export) - Flags & Negatable Booleans
exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --
stdout '"tag":"longhand flags"'
stdout '"value":"--env"'
stdout '"value":"--region"'
stdout '"value":"--cluster"'
stdout '"value":"--image"'
stdout '"value":"--features"'
stdout '"value":"--manifest"'
stdout '"value":"--out-dir"'
stdout '"value":"--dry-run"'
stdout '"value":"--no-dry-run"'
stdout '"value":"--profile"'
stdout '"value":"--kubeconfig"'

exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --no
stdout '"value":"--no-dry-run"'

# 6. Dynamic completion (JSON export) - Enum flag values
exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --env=
stdout '"value":"--env=staging"'
stdout '"value":"--env=production"'
stdout '"value":"--env=qa"'

exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --env=pr
stdout '"value":"--env=production"'

exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --env st
stdout '"value":"staging"'

# 7. Self-completing domain types implementing conga.Predictable (Region & Profile)
exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --region ''
stdout '"value":"us-east-1"'
stdout '"description":"North America \(N\. Virginia\)"'
stdout '"value":"eu-west-1"'
stdout '"value":"ap-southeast-1"'

exec cloudctl __complete export --profile ''
stdout '"value":"production"'
stdout '"description":"Production workloads"'
stdout '"value":"staging"'
stdout '"value":"development"'

# 8. Domain-type file filtering (FileFilterable), directory completion
#    (conga.Dir), and file completion (conga.File)
exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --manifest=
stdout '"value":"--manifest=app.yaml"'
stdout '"value":"--manifest=config.yml"'
! stdout '"value":"--manifest=ignore.txt"'

exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --out-dir=
stdout '"value":"--out-dir=build/"'
! stdout '"value":"--out-dir=app.yaml"'

exec cloudctl __complete export --kubeconfig ''
stdout '"value":"app.yaml"'
stdout '"value":"presets.conf"'
stdout '"value":"ignore.txt"'

# 9. Dynamic contextual domain type completion (Cluster via predict.Callback)
exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --cluster st
stdout '"value":"staging-cluster-alpha"'
stdout '"value":"staging-cluster-beta"'

exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --env production --cluster prod
stdout '"value":"prod-us-east-1"'
stdout '"value":"prod-eu-west-1"'
stdout '"value":"prod-ap-southeast-1"'

# 10. Segmented MultiParts domain type completion (Image via predict.MultiParts(":"))
exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --image a
stdout '"value":"api-gateway:"'
stdout '"value":"auth-service:"'

exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --image auth-service:
stdout '"value":"auth-service:v1.0.0"'
stdout '"value":"auth-service:v1.1.0"'
stdout '"value":"auth-service:v1.2.0"'
stdout '"value":"auth-service:latest"'

# 11. Domain-type slice completion with deduplication (Feature via predict.Values)
exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --features c
stdout '"value":"canary"'

exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --features canary,
! stdout '"value":"canary,canary"'
stdout '"value":"canary,tracing"'

exec cloudctl __complete export deploy --features canary --features ''
! stdout '"value":"canary"'
stdout '"value":"tracing"'
stdout '"value":"metrics"'

# 12. Map predictor (MapValues) on a map[string]string flag
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --labels t
stdout '"value":"team="'
stdout '"value":"tier="'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --labels team=
stdout '"value":"team=core"'
stdout '"value":"team=frontend"'
stdout '"value":"team=infra"'
stdout '"value":"team=security"'

# Key deduplication: when team=core is selected, team= key is excluded
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --labels team=core,t
! stdout '"value":"team=core,team="'
stdout '"value":"team=core,tier="'

# 13. Value predictors and combinators: KeepOrder, Items (display/style/tag),
#     Map, Prefix, Suffix, Batch, Timeout fallback, Getenv
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --severity ''
stdout '"value":"debug"'
stdout '"value":"info"'
stdout '"value":"warn"'
stdout '"value":"error"'
stdout '"keeporder":true'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --sink ''
stdout '"value":"stdout"'
stdout '"display":"stdout \(console\)"'
stdout '"style":"dim"'
stdout '"tag":"sinks"'
stdout '"value":"syslog"'
stdout '"description":"Forward to a syslog collector \(UDP 514\)"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --sink-mode ''
stdout '"value":"buffered"'
stdout '"description":"Coalesce writes into 64KiB buffers"'
stdout '"value":"direct"'
stdout '"value":"unbuffered"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --bucket ''
stdout '"value":"s3://logs-primary"'
stdout '"display":"logs-primary"'
stdout '"style":"cyan"'
stdout '"value":"s3://logs-replica"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --collector ''
stdout '"value":"collector-a:5514"'
stdout '"value":"collector-b:5514"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --endpoint ''
stdout '"value":"http://logs.local"'
stdout '"value":"https://logs.internal"'
stdout '"value":"unix:///var/run/log.sock"'

# The slow shard registry misses the predictor Timeout, so the fallback list wins
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --shard ''
stdout '"value":"shard-0"'
stdout '"value":"shard-1"'
stdout '"value":"shard-2"'
! stdout '"value":"shard-9"'

# Context.Getenv reads the completion environment ($PAGER)
env PAGER=custom-pager-demo
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --pager ''
stdout '"value":"custom-pager-demo"'

# 14. Filesystem predictors: Files, FilesGlob, Dirs, FilesFiltered,
#     PathsFiltered, FileLines, FileContents (+custom parser), Executables,
#     Symlinks, None
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --out-file ''
stdout '"value":"app.log"'
stdout '"value":"server.log"'
! stdout '"value":"app.yaml"'

# FilesGlob matches multiple name patterns
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --glob-log ''
stdout '"value":"app.log"'
stdout '"value":"server.log"'
stdout '"value":"ignore.txt"'
! stdout '"value":"app.yaml"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --log-dir ''
stdout '"value":"build/"'
stdout '"value":"2024-01/"'
! stdout '"value":"app.log"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --archive ''
stdout '"value":"archive.log.gz"'
! stdout '"value":"app.log"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --node-dir ''
stdout '"value":"2024-01/"'
! stdout '"value":"build/"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --log-path ''
stdout '"value":"app.yaml"'
stdout '"value":"build/"'
! stdout '"value":"config.yml"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --preset ''
stdout '"value":"errors-only"'
stdout '"value":"slow-requests"'
! stdout '"value":"comment-lines-are-skipped"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --label-key ''
stdout '"value":"team"'
stdout '"description":"label from labels.conf"'
stdout '"value":"tier"'
! stdout '"value":"junk-without-equals"'

# Executables resolves binaries from $PATH
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --editor go
stdout '"value":"go"'
stdout '"tag":"executables"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs --hook ''
stdout '"value":"hook.conf"'
stdout '"description":"-> presets.conf"'

# None suppresses candidates and file fallback entirely
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --silent ''
stdout '"candidates":\[\]'

# 15. FlagValues dedup: already-muted services are excluded from the next value
exec cloudctl __complete export logs --mute api,
! stdout '"value":"api,api"'
stdout '"value":"api,auth"'
stdout '"value":"api,billing"'
stdout '"value":"api,frontend"'

# 16. Programmatic predictor evaluation: Invoke, Raw, Filter, and Tag
#     (flag completion tags candidates with the engine's own "values" tag,
#     so the predictor tag is asserted on the programmatic result instead)
exec cloudctl logs api --list-candidates
stdout 'Severities: \[debug info warn error\]'
stdout 'Severities matching "w": \[warn\]'
stdout 'KeepOrder directive: true'
stdout 'Tag: severities'

# 17. Positional argument enums & simultaneous flags
exec cloudctl __complete export logs a
stdout '"value":"auth"'
stdout '"value":"api"'

exec cloudctl __complete export logs ''
stdout '"tag":"arguments"'
stdout '"value":"auth"'
stdout '"value":"billing"'
stdout '"value":"api"'
stdout '"value":"frontend"'
stdout '"tag":"longhand flags"'
stdout '"value":"--env"'
stdout '"value":"--follow"'
stdout '"value":"--profile"'
stdout '"value":"--help"'

# 18. Unconstrained positional argument with active help and flags
exec cloudctl __complete export deploy ''
stdout 'Service name to deploy'
stdout '"tag":"longhand flags"'
stdout '"value":"--env"'
stdout '"value":"--region"'
stdout '"value":"--cluster"'
stdout '"value":"--image"'
stdout '"value":"--features"'
stdout '"value":"--dry-run"'
stdout '"value":"--profile"'
stdout '"value":"--kubeconfig"'
stdout '"value":"--help"'

# 19. Hierarchical contextual argument autocompletion (pods predictor evaluated
#     from the global --profile and the subcommand --namespace)
exec cloudctl __complete export exec ''
stdout '"usage":"target pod in staging/backend"'
stdout '"tag":"arguments"'
stdout '"value":"api-stage-alpha"'
stdout '"value":"auth-stage-beta"'
stdout '"tag":"longhand flags"'
stdout '"value":"--namespace"'
stdout '"value":"--container"'
stdout '"value":"--profile"'
stdout '"value":"--help"'

exec cloudctl __complete export exec --namespace frontend ''
stdout '"usage":"target pod in staging/frontend"'
stdout '"value":"web-stage-1"'
stdout '"value":"web-stage-2"'
! stdout '"value":"api-stage-alpha"'

exec cloudctl __complete export --profile production exec --namespace database ''
stdout '"usage":"target pod in production/database"'
stdout '"value":"pg-primary-0"'
stdout '"value":"redis-prod-node-1"'
! stdout '"value":"pg-stage-0"'

# Root flag supplied after subcommand
exec cloudctl __complete export exec --namespace database --profile development ''
stdout '"usage":"target pod in development/database"'
stdout '"value":"pg-dev-local"'
stdout '"value":"redis-dev-local"'

# 20. Command argument completion driven by Context.Arg, LastArg, and HasFlag:
#     per-pod commands, container-level diagnostics, and default shells
exec cloudctl __complete export exec web-prod-1 ''
stdout '"usage":"known commands for pod web-prod-1"'
stdout '"value":"nginx -t"'
stdout '"value":"tail -n 100 /var/log/nginx/access.log"'

exec cloudctl __complete export exec --container app web-prod-1 ''
stdout '"usage":"container-level diagnostics"'
stdout '"value":"sh -c ''env'''

# An unregistered pod target falls through to the default shells (Arg(0) echo)
exec cloudctl __complete export exec api-stage-alpha ''
stdout '"usage":"default shells \(pod \\"api-stage-alpha\\"'
stdout '"value":"/bin/sh"'
stdout '"value":"/bin/bash"'

# 21. Exclude drops sidecars from container completion
exec cloudctl __complete export exec --container ''
stdout '"value":"app"'
stdout '"value":"cache"'
! stdout '"value":"istio-proxy"'

# 22. Fish formatting
exec cloudctl __complete fish deploy --
stdout '--env\tTarget deployment environment'
stdout '--region\tTarget cloud region \(self-completing\)'
stdout '--cluster\tTarget cluster \(contextual\)'
stdout '--dry-run\tSimulate deployment'
stdout '--profile\tGlobal cloud profile'
stdout '--kubeconfig\tPath to kubeconfig file'

# 23. Interactive TAB simulation via COMP_LINE with mismatched executable name
env 'COMP_LINE=./custom-named-binary deploy --'
exec cloudctl __complete export
stdout '"value":"--env"'
stdout '"value":"--region"'
stdout '"value":"--cluster"'
stdout '"value":"--image"'
stdout '"value":"--features"'
stdout '"value":"--dry-run"'
stdout '"value":"--profile"'
stdout '"value":"--help"'

-- app.yaml --
name: app
-- config.yml --
port: 8080
-- ignore.txt --
ignore
-- build/placeholder --
placeholder
-- 2024-01/placeholder --
placeholder
-- app.log --
placeholder
-- server.log --
placeholder
-- archive.log.gz --
placeholder
-- presets.conf --
# comment-lines-are-skipped
errors-only
slow-requests
-- labels.conf --
# comment-lines-are-skipped
team=core
tier=backend
junk-without-equals
